summary.intent: Land PR 87 (delete unread analyzer output) and make sure it combines cleanly with PR 88 (bounded reads and add timeout), after a subagent reported resolving PR 87's merge conflicts with main.
summary.outcome: Independently test-merged the two branches and found the combined state failed because the scaling test still referenced a field deleted in PR 87. Merged the deletion into the bounded-reads branch, removed the stale field from the scaling test, ran `just ci` and the harness on the combined state, and committed the fix. The transcript doesn't show the check results or a push.

repo: Repo is a Rust workspace (crates/monokl) with checks run via `just ci` and `just machete` (unused deps), plus `python3 -I scripts/rg-compare.py` as a scoring harness against pinned repos.

PRs 87 and 88 each merge cleanly with main or each other textually, yet the combined state failed tests because the scaling test used a field PR 87 deleted. Textual merge cleanliness doesn't guarantee a compiling or passing combination.

PR 87 conflicts with main were in crates/monokl/src/types.rs (kept main's SymbolKind::as_str and dropped Visibility, SymbolEntry, Dependency*, Export, Jsx*, TsData, LangData) and crates/monokl/src/output/agent.rs (search_row uses Value::from(node_kind.as_str()) plus parent_cell(block.block.parent.as_ref())).

code.finding: Only file auto-merged when combining PR 88 with PR 87; no conflicts.
search_row combines main's Value::from(node_kind.as_str()) with parent_cell(block.block.parent.as_ref()) after conflict resolution.

workflow: The subagent's hand-back is not authoritative, so the assistant re-verified by fetching both branches, test-merging, and running the full suite itself.
Judge checks by exit code (e.g. `just ci`) rather than by reading output.
Byte-comparing stdout, stderr and exit code against an origin/main build over 171 queries is a good regression check for deletion-only refactors.
Use a scratch worktree or checkout for test merges and abort or remove it afterwards to keep the main worktree clean.

friction: Combined 87+88 state failed even though each branch passed alone, so the cause had to be tracked down (stale field in the scaling test).
The subagent had to re-run `just ci` only to read its exit code.
open_items: The scaling-test fix is committed on the bounded-reads branch (PR 88) merge state but the transcript doesn't show it pushed; confirm before publishing.
Merge order for PRs 87 and 88 still needs settling, and the other branch may need the same fix once the first lands.
